The video begins by loading the real D&D Beyond site. After the site navigation, loading animation, and privacy banner appear, the demo sheet loads as a character sheet with red print-enhancer outlines around many sections.

Around 30 seconds, the extension’s dark **Beyond Print Enhancer** panel appears on the left, while a **Layer Management** panel appears on the right. A toast states, “No saved layout yet — the default template is loaded,” and the sheet visibly changes from the red print view to a black-and-white template layout.

The following modal interactions are visibly shown:

1. A **Rename Layer** dialog opens with the current name “Shapes (Default).” The name field is cleared, and pressing **Continue** produces the visible validation message: “Enter a name to continue — the field cannot be empty.” The modal then closes.
2. A **Select Decorative Shape** modal opens, showing border/style filters, a search field, and decorative shape thumbnails such as Archer Ability, Archer Finial, Archer Header, and Archer Outline. It is then closed without a clearly visible selection.
3. A **Templates** modal opens with visible **Basic Template** and **Archiver Template** entries, layout options, preview thumbnails, and a **Cancel** button. This modal remains open when the video ends.

No visible capture artifact, screenshot export, or completed migrated-dialog placement on the sheet is shown. The video does visibly demonstrate multiple modal openings, one input-validation affordance, modal dismissal, and the template-loaded sheet state, but the asserted “captures the migrated dialog, the untouched dialogs” behavior is not visibly completed.
